player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ee ciyaarta wareega {max_rounds} ee Kuhn Poker. Xeerarka ciyaarta: - Kuhn Poker wuxuu isticmaalaa 3-kaar kaar oo leh J, Q, K (J ugu hooseeya, K ugu sarreeya) - Ciyaaryahan kasta wuxuu hormariyaa {ante} jajab wuxuuna helayaa 1 kaar wareeg kasta (Xusuusnow in kaararka la siiyay iyada oo aan la beddelin, sidaa darteed ma heli kartid kaarka la mid ah kan kaa soo horjeeda). - Ciyaarta ayaa sii socota wareega {max_rounds} - Ciyaaryahanka leh jajabka ugu badan ka dib wareegyada oo dhan ayaa guuleysta Xeerarka ficil: - '[check]': Gudub iyada oo aan la sharadayn (kaliya haddii khamaar uusan miiska saarneyn) - '[bet]': Ku dar 1 jajab saxaarad (kaliya haddii khamaar uusan miiska saarneyn) - '[call]': Isku dar khamaarka ka soo horjeeda adigoo ku daraya 1 saxaarad saxaarad - '[fold]': Iskaliya gacantaada oo u oggolow in kaa soo horjeedaadu ku guuleysato saxaarad

showdown.showdown_summary: Isku soo wada duuboo: Ciyaaryahanka {winner} ee {winner_card} ayaa garaacaya Ciyaaryahanka {loser} ee {loser_card}. Ciyaaryahanka {winner} wuxuu ku guuleystaa dheriga {pot_value} jajab.

outcome.draw: Dhamaadka wareegyada {max_rounds}, labada ciyaartoy waxay lahaayeen tiro isku mid ah oo jajab ah.
